items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-05-11
items.q: Another fellow up there, Dick Allen, interviewed him.

ctx.x: I think I recall that. Not positive. I want to say for sure that I do. But offhand, I do remember him carrying a small package.

Anything, let's see, Alvin Alcorn, of course, was over here for a while, I understand, and played with you. He was interviewed for Tulane, too, but I've never heard his interview. Another fellow up there, Dick Allen, interviewed him.

Well, yes, he was a mainstay in my band for years. I got Mickey. We call him Mickey. Mickey Alcorn. I brought him out of New Orleans when he was a kid, too. I never heard him call that Mickey. Mickey. I never heard him. Just when you see him, say, hi, Mickey. Yeah. I never heard anybody call him that over there.

items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1961-06-06
items.q: You said that Dick Allen had asked you to get a few questions for me?

ctx.x: You said that Dick Allen had asked you to get a few questions for me?
Yeah. You said that uh... A few questions and he wanted me to tell you a few things. That's mighty fine. Or maybe you could tell me about Bill Phillips.
